sentences: While the army was marching, the king fell ill.
By the time the war ended, the empire had already collapsed.
She was reading about the revolution when she found an old letter.
They had never seen such a battle before it happened.
The queen was ruling the country when the rebellion started.
The explorers had sailed for months before they discovered the island.
While historians were studying the ruins, they found new evidence.
The dynasty had lasted for centuries before it finally fell.

grammar.title: Tempos Narrativos: Past Simple + Past Continuous + Past Perfect
rules: Past simple conta a ação principal da história: The king fell ill.
Past continuous descreve uma ação em andamento no passado, o cenário: The army was marching.
Past perfect mostra o que já tinha acontecido antes da ação principal: The empire had already collapsed.
Combinamos os três tempos para dar profundidade à narrativa: While the army was marching, the king fell ill, because the empire had already collapsed.

rows: ação anterior a outra no passado
While the army was marching, the king fell ill because the empire had collapsed.
